🔄 Content Updated (Published: November 23, 2026 / Previous: September 26, 2026)
Main Changes: Dates changed to January 19 and 30. The January 30 gathering location has been unified to Hanno City Hall West Parking Lot (changed from Hanno City Hall Annex Front).

Sugo-ashi Leisurely Walk January will be held.

Dates: January 19 (Tuesday) and January 30 (Saturday), 2027 (Reiwa 9)

Gathering Time: 10:00 a.m.

Gathering Place: Hanno City Hall West Parking Lot

Course: Two routes will be selected based on weather and number of participants
• Course (1): City Hall → Benzaiten Shrine → Chikkanji Temple → Nakayama West Signal → Yatsuda → Ninin-ji Temple → Chuo Park → Hongocho Water Purification Plant → Hanno River Stepping Stones Bridge → Hanno Station → Higashi-Hanno Station → Hanno City Hall
• Course (2): City Hall → Hanno City area (Shimokaji, Soyagi, Kaji) → Iruma City area (Shinko, Noda) → Fushiko Station (return by train)

Distance: Approximately 7 kilometers

Planned Duration: Approximately 2 hours 30 minutes

Fee: Free (participants are responsible for their own insurance)

What to Bring: Drinking water, rain gear, transportation IC card, Sugo-ashi handbook (if you have one)

Registration: Same-day participation (please arrive by the gathering time)

Cancellation Check: To confirm cancellations due to weather or other reasons, contact Onda at 090-2205-8073 after 3:00 p.m. the day before.

Host: Hanno Walking Club

Source (Japanese): https://www.city.hanno.lg.jp/soshikikarasagasu/kenkohukusibu/hokencenter/11102.html
summary: ℹ️ Sugo-ashi Event: Sugo-ashi Leisurely Walk in January on Tuesday, January 19 and Saturday, January 30, 2027
